title: Bacterial Transformation Protocol
author: Dana Mozaffari
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8irhud6
materials: Thaw a tube of NEB 10-beta Competent E. coli cells on ice for 10 minutes

steps.title: Add DNA to cells
steps.instruction: Add 1–5 µl of plasmid DNA (1 pg–100 ng) to the cell mixture, then flick the tube 4–5 times to mix (do not vortex).

steps.title: Ice incubation (30 min)
steps.instruction: Place the tube on ice for 30 minutes without mixing.

steps.title: Heat shock (42°C, 30 s)
steps.instruction: Heat‑shock at exactly 42 °C for exactly 30 seconds; do not mix.

steps.title: Ice recovery (5 min)
steps.instruction: Return the tube to ice for 5 minutes; do not mix.

steps.title: Add outgrowth medium
steps.instruction: Pipette 950 µl of room‑temperature NEB 10‑beta/Stable Outgrowth Medium into the mixture.

steps.title: Incubate with shaking
steps.instruction: Incubate at 37 °C for 60 minutes with vigorous shaking (250 rpm) or rotation.

steps.title: Plate dilutions and incubate
steps.instruction: Spread 50–100 µl of each dilution onto a selection plate and incubate overnight at 37 °C, or alternatively at 30 °C for 24–36 h or at 25 °C for 48 h.

steps.title: Miniprep DNA from cultures
steps.instruction: Purify plasmid DNA from the selected cultures using a DNA miniprep kit.
